title: Final Energies
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly state the first-order energies E^{(1)}_0 and E^{(1)}_{±}.

title: Final Wave Functions
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct first-order wave functions |ψ'_0⟩ and |ψ^{(1)}_{±}⟩.

title: Matrix Elements
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly calculate the matrix elements H'_{ij} for the perturbation.

title: Secular Equation
description: Important Criteria: The student must derive and solve the secular equation correctly to find the energy levels.

title: Degenerate States
description: Important Criteria: The student should identify the three-fold degeneracy of the first excited state correctly.

title: Perturbation Form
description: Optional Criteria: The student should clearly state the form of the perturbation H' = bxy.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect matrix element calculations.
